Hello everybody, I am a 22 year old engineering college student with one year left. I would like to take this moment to try and explain my idea behind this subverse. I will do my best to stay on topic and be concise, but even now my thoughts are rather jumbled so please bear with me. First I will give a brief background to the creation of this subverse then I will go into how I imagine these subverse

Background We live in a beautiful age where information omnipresent. We have access to news, data, and information from across the globe. However, one side affect of this is that I have slowly grown more and more pessimistic as I have learned more about this world. Nearly everything I did research on seemed to be raising alarm bells and screaming for help. Things such as climate change threatening our current world, overpopulation apparently telling us we are already doomed, and even suburban sprawl is linked to all sorts of maladies. Now I understand some of these problems may be overblown and others downplayed, that's not the point I am trying to make here. What I am getting at is this instilled the idea in me that we had to change to save this beautiful planet we live on and yet it seemed nothing was being done. So I decided I would change the world. Why not? With a chip on my shoulder and spite in my eyes I was going to be damned if I let those in charge ruin us. In my eyes the generation from the 60s were the most disappointing generation out there. They preached about saving the world and now they were the ones destroying it. So I was going to do everything I could to change the world. God I was dumb. The world is not so cut and dry. Overall the aggregate of humankind is good. People want to be happy and others to be with them. I was being too pessimistic and letting the soundbites get to me. After all, recently the White House raised $4 billion to develop solar and the Pope released a paper on climate change and immigration. Humanity was pulling through. However, the world is a cruel place. Then that kid went and killed those people. He was my fucking age man. How could he go through with something like that at my age? Those were good people and he knew it. Yet in his lifetime, everything he saw added up to a distorted, fucked up view of where the world was going and what needed to be done. However, this attack has taught me quite a few things. One is that the strength of humanity is working together. We are a social creature, and depriving yourself of these connections will just make things harder for no reason and can be dangerous in some cases. It's time we started working together.

What This Subverse Is For I want this subverse to be a place for people of our generation to work together. The generation of people who will soon hold the hold the future of the world in their hands (I am generalizing that the average person on stuff like this is in their 20s). We have more tools at our disposal than any other generation before us, it would be a shame if we didn't use them to fulfill our aspirations whatever they may be. I believe that our generation reads too much and does to little. It's easy to read all these things on the internet about how to learn skills, how to fix the government and yet the truly hard thing is to act upon the things we read. There is a time to learn things, and there is a time to get out there experience them. I would like this to be a place for people to do both of these and more importantly to do it with somebody. Maybe you like me and consider yourself introverted and like to do everything on your own, or not. Either way I would like this to be a platform for people to work on their goals with other people involved. Our generation will do amazing things. I can't wait to see what happens in my lifetime, but it is time we start doing something.

Post Ideas Right now, I admit this place will be a sort of free for all on what to post as honestly there is nobody else here. So here are my current ideas on what types of post would go here:

  1. Post about what your goals are, things you want to learn, anything you want to accomplish from saving the planet to learning a language. Something that gives us a general idea of where you are and how we can help. This also helps us make sure that you are actually doing things instead of just spending all your time here. Maybe post a time frame so people can check up on you?

  2. Make a boast post. Brag about what you accomplished today. Maybe it will get others off their ass to do something to.

  3. Post an article that you think is important to a certain cause. Post that shit so people can learn about it and discuss it. Just no bullshit

Please feel free to make any suggestions. At the end of the day I have no idea if this subverse makes any sense or if people will use it. Figured I'd give it a shot. Better to try it than to do nothing.

Thank you for taking the time to read this jumbled mess.
